arxiv-1807-02953.title: RACK: Automatic API Recommendation using Crowdsourced Knowledge
arxiv-1807-02953.creator: Mohammad Masudur Rahman Chanchal K. Roy † David Lo
arxiv-1807-02953.description: Abstract Traditional code search engines often do not perform well with natural language queries since they mostly apply keyword matching. These engines thus need carefully designed queries containing information about programming APIs for code search. Unfortunately, existing studies suggest that preparing an effective code search query is both challenging and time consuming for the developers.

arxiv-2109-09583.title: Collinear approach for top quark production at ep colliders
arxiv-2109-09583.creator: G.R.Boroun
arxiv-2109-09583.description: Abstract An approximately analysis study of the collinear approach for t ​ t ¯ t\overline{t} production at the Future Circular Collider hadron-electron (FCC-he) and the Large Hadron electron Collider (LHeC) is performed. To study heavy quark production processes, the collinear generalized double asymptotic scaling (DAS) approach in a wide rang of Q 2 Q^{2} is used.

arxiv-2210-01700.title: Spin-orbit enhancement in Si/SiGe heterostructures with oscillating Ge concentration
arxiv-2210-01700.creator: Benjamin D. Woods, M. A. Eriksson, Robert Joynt, Mark Friesen
arxiv-2210-01700.description: Abstract We show that Ge concentration oscillations within the quantum well region of a Si/SiGe heterostructure can significantly enhance the spin-orbit coupling of the low-energy conduction-band valleys. Specifically, we find that for Ge oscillation wavelengths near λ = 1.57 ​ nm \lambda=1.

arxiv-2308-06989.title: Gate-tunable kinetic inductance parametric amplifier
arxiv-2308-06989.creator: Lukas Johannes Splitthoff 1,2, Jaap Joachim Wesdorp 1,2, Marta Pita-Vidal 1,2, Arno Bargerbos 1,2, Yu Liu 3, Christian Kraglund Andersen 1,2
arxiv-2308-06989.description: Abstract Superconducting parametric amplifiers play a crucial role in the preparation and readout of quantum states at microwave frequencies, enabling high-fidelity measurements of superconducting qubits. Most existing implementations of these amplifiers rely on the nonlinearity from Josephson junctions, superconducting quantum interference devices or disordered superconductors. Additionally, frequency tunability arises typically from either flux or current biasing.

arxiv-2509-20942.title: Why Attention Fails: The Degeneration of Transformers into MLPs in Time Series Forecasting
arxiv-2509-20942.creator: Liang Zida, Jiayi Zhu, Weiqiang Sun
arxiv-2509-20942.description: Abstract Transformer-based architectures achieved high performance in natural language processing and computer vision, yet many studies have shown that they have not demonstrated a clear advantage in time series forecasting and even underperform simple linear baselines in some cases. However, most of these studies have not thoroughly explored the reasons behind the failure of transformers.

pmc-11327626.title: Smartphone-Based Smoking Cessation Intervention (OKquit) for Oklahoma Tobacco Helpline Users: Protocol for a Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-11327626.creator: Michael Businelle, Jessica Becerra, Carl Witten, Sixia Chen, Krista Kezbers, Laura A Beebe, Darla E Kendzor
pmc-11327626.description: BackgroundTobacco quitlines provide effective resources (eg, nicotine replacement therapy, smoking cessation counseling, and text and web-based support) for those who want to quit smoking in the United States. However, quitlines reach approximately only 1%-3% of people who smoke each year.

pmc-11476939.title: Towards accurate screening and prevention for PTSD (2-ASAP): protocol of a longitudinal prospective cohort study
pmc-11476939.creator: Jeanet F. Karchoud, Chris M. Hoeboer, Greta Piwanski, Juanita A. Haagsma, Miranda Olff, Rens van de Schoot, Mirjam van Zuiden
pmc-11476939.description: BackgroundEffective preventive interventions for PTSD rely on early identification of individuals at risk for developing PTSD. To establish early post-trauma who are at risk, there is a need for accurate prognostic risk screening instruments for PTSD that can be widely implemented in recently trauma-exposed adults. Achieving such accuracy and generalizability requires external validation of machine learning classification models.

pmc-11772479.title: Perspective on the role of norms for institutional behavior and policy design in European cross-border regions
pmc-11772479.creator: Sara Svensson
pmc-11772479.description: The article analyses how a norm scientific perspective can advance our understanding of cross-border regions and guide future directions of research. Cross-border regions are territorial spaces comprising territory from two or more national states, located directly at the borders of those spaces.

pmc-11788283.title: The characteristics of chronic benzene poisoning in 176 Chinese occupational population cases
pmc-11788283.creator: Lian Gou, Xingyu Ma, Lili Huang, Mei Qiu, Ruiqing Guo, Jun Jia, Peiyu Xu, Nan Lian
pmc-11788283.description: Benzene is a widespread environmental carcinogen known to induce leukemia. Chronic benzene poisoning is a significant occupational health issue in China, particularly among workers exposed to benzene. The aim of this study was to analyze the distribution patterns and trends of occupational benzene poisoning cases.

pmc-13167006.title: Impact of diabetes mellitus in patients undergoing radiation therapy for head and neck cancer
pmc-13167006.creator: Silpa Johnson, Sandeep Muzumder, Hadrian Noel Alexander F, Nirmala Srikantia, Avinash H Udayashankara, Swathi R. Krishna, Deepu C Tom, John M. Raj
pmc-13167006.description: BackgroundThe study aims to find the impact of diabetes mellitus (DM) in patients undergoing radiation therapy (RT) for head and neck cancer (HNC).Materials and methodsThe retrospective cohort study analysed 346 HNC patients who received definitive or adjuvant RT with or without chemotherapy from January 2013 to December 2023.

pmc-13299482.title: Evaluation of Different Strategies to Incorporate Absolute Abundance into Habitat Selection Modeling for the Endangered Cheirotonus jansoni
pmc-13299482.creator: Tianwu Ma, Rui Guo, Qian Lei, Zhangfeng Cheng, Qingyun Wang, Qiao Li, Hong Wu, Junhao Huang, Liwei Liu
pmc-13299482.description: Simple SummaryInsect surveys record not only where a species is found but also the number of individuals caught at each site. These counts can be used to assign importance to different locations when creating maps that predict where a species is likely to live.

pmc-13372118.title: Predicting ankylosing spondylitis disease activity via patient-reported outcome measures: Building prediction models based on machine learning
pmc-13372118.creator: Yifan Gong, Aomei Liu, Li Zhuo, Xueyuan Xu, Hongxiao Liu
pmc-13372118.description: ObjectiveDisease activity is a critical indicator for monitoring the progression of ankylosing spondylitis (AS), guiding clinical decision-making, and informing treatment plans. Patient-reported outcome measures (PROMs) have gained prominence in AS clinical management. However, their potential to predict Ankylosing Spondylitis Disease Activity Score-C-reactive protein (ASDAS-CRP) remains unexplored.

pmc-13429388.title: Pneumococcal transmission is driven by TNFR2+ regulatory T-cells
pmc-13429388.creator: Daan Beentjes, James Murray, Neil French, Caroline Vipond, Rong Xu, Aras Kadioglu
pmc-13429388.description: BackgroundPneumococcal serotype 1 (sequence type 217) is a leading cause of invasive disease outbreaks in Sub-Saharan Africa, causing significant morbidity and mortality. Understanding the transmission dynamics of hypervirulent strains such as ST217 is key to developing therapies and vaccines that can reduce outbreak incidence.

pmc-13550453.title: Using ensemble learning and explainable AI to predict bank marketing customer subscription
pmc-13550453.creator: Wenyue Wang, Qi Liu, Sufeng Li, Hongyan Feng

pmc-13652469.title: Staged surgical management of advanced MRONJ in a nonagenarian with severe infection: extensive segmental mandibulectomy and reconstruction
pmc-13652469.creator: Miki Yamada, Yosuke Iijima, Miyabi Mori, Shunsuke Hino, Norio Horie, Takahiro Kaneko
pmc-13652469.description: Introduction:The management of advanced medication-related osteonecrosis of the jaw (MRONJ) in very elderly patients remains controversial because of concerns regarding perioperative risk. This report describes the clinical course and outcome of staged surgical management in a nonagenarian patient with advanced MRONJ complicated by severe infection.

pmc-13688905.title: The impact of educational video about preeclampsia on pregnant women’s knowledge: a quasi-experimental study
pmc-13688905.creator: Sumayah Alrehaili, Hanan Badr, Amal Sijini, Mohammed Ali Saghir
pmc-13688905.description: BackgroundPreeclampsia is a severe hypertensive condition that may occur during pregnancy, posing significant risks to both the mother and the fetus. Educating pregnant women about this condition is essential for its recognition and the prevention of complications. This study aimed to examine the impact of educational videos about preeclampsia on pregnant women’s knowledge.
